scope: Research map and future native case specifications, not expected Go results or completed capability claims.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Apple recursively validates host code, checks host-reported dynamic flags and compares the dynamic CDHash with disk. KernelCode obtains flags/hash via ProcessCode::csops. Non-Darwin hosts cannot obtain a macOS kernel state by verifying a file.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Specify any allowed real process-state provider and cross-host meaning explicitly; snapshots alone cannot close native live-state equivalence.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Isolated test keychains establish existing native signing controls; no portable implementation supplies the user search list, unlock/ACL authorization and protected keys.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Obtain a permitted real store/provider protocol; test isolated exact-name/hash/preference/duplicate/locked decisions without using unrelated user keychains.

phase_prerequisites.finding: The native null detached destination calls SignatureDatabaseWriter::storeCode. The pinned implementation uses SQLite plus native database paths/permissions; an offline codec is not registration in the active native store.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Define an isolated native database test environment and permitted actual-store access; implement portable codec/transaction mechanics without claiming live registration.

phase_prerequisites.finding: crypto.Signer can carry a provider-backed signing operation, but a certificate does not grant access to its non-exportable key.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Supply an authorized test device/service and reviewed pure-Go protocol; qualify algorithms, authorization, cancellation and signature output against the actual identity.

phase_prerequisites.finding: The source passes digest and algorithm identifiers into SecCodeRemoteSignHandler and wraps its signature into CMS. This callback is not evidence of a portable network wire protocol.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Capture the current CLI provider selection and obtain a real authorized handler/service contract. Do not substitute a reference project remote protocol as native equivalence.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Executing an arbitrary native signing library conflicts with the no-native-binding production boundary.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Retain the blocker unless the user changes that boundary; a pure-Go signer API does not execute arbitrary native dylibs.

phase_prerequisites.finding: An arbitrary external allocator override has execution behavior that a built-in pure-Go allocator does not provide under the no-helper boundary.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Implement built-in allocation but retain override parity as blocked unless the original constraint changes.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Current parser recognition does not identify hybrid algorithms, slot wire formats or detached certificate interchange; the pinned older public source cannot prove current private policy.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Obtain legitimate native hybrid identities/outputs and authorized signing access; record actual algorithms and complete native slot/merge cases before choosing crypto dependencies.

phase_prerequisites.finding: The applicability probe can emit validation errors with exit zero. SDK slots/parser recognition alone do not establish versioned schema, warning policy or runtime enforcement.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Capture full schema/type/operator and signing-slot cases, including warning/failure ordering. Record private CoreEntitlements gaps explicitly.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Existing public synthetic chains qualify the supported subset; look-alike markers cannot qualify actual Apple issuance/purpose policy.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Use legitimate Apple-issued public fixtures and authorized disposable credentials for positive signing; retain synthetic negative controls.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Published bodies delegate ticket registration/lookup to SecAssessment services, with different default/forced-online calls. A false return can reflect service errors; the AST does not authenticate tickets.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Capture legitimate tickets, trust/binding and cache/freshness decisions and investigate service protocol; separate portable verification from current remote status.

phase_prerequisites.finding: The baseline rejects HTTPS TSA URLs; separate issuer/revocation/notary services may require secure transport. Existing net/http and crypto/tls paths violate the production Darwin-bridge guard.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Audit a portable authenticated transport implementation without relaxing guards; do not mislabel baseline HTTPS TSA rejection as a missing native feature.

phase_prerequisites.finding: Six disposable-filesystem controls show native sign/dry-run/remove succeeding on APFS and HFS+. Released go-apfs-v2 v0.17.0 prepares replacements on APFS but fails with ENOTSUP on HFS+, preventing all three Go operations. Raw copyfile metadata policy and the SDK source-preservation contract are distinct.
phase_prerequisites.resolution: Published v0.17.1 consumed in merged codesign PR98 after complete three-OS CI run 37192438601, including 108 mounted APFS/HFS+ writer comparisons and retained foreign-producer verification. Preserve all remaining Phase 02 lifecycle and metadata-policy obligations.

apis.decision: Reuse rooted staging/restore/cleanup; complete codesign checkpoint behavior before proposing an upstream extension.
Reuse existing platform metadata restoration; do not duplicate the fixed deny-write ACL staging implementation.
Streaming reconstruction already exists; signing unchanged compressed payload does not require reconstructing a filesystem.
Use existing footer/range model; audit signature adapter restrictions separately from SDK codec capability.
Released non-cloning fallback; reuse bounded xattr copying and streamed resource forks. Native codesign metadata policy remains consumer work.
Merged PR198 main pin uses fresh staging for compressed sources, preserving independent resource forks and target compression flags. Recompression remains a separate prerequisite.
Released sparse rooted staging and metadata restoration; keep NTFS sparse cases mandatory and reuse SDK ownership.
Released bounded backup stream filter preserves sparse named data and excludes original main-data extents from replacement.
Merged PR198: fresh staging for compressed sources and restoration using the target compression state. Reuse the SDK implementation; native lifecycle comparison remains codesign policy evidence.

prerequisite_findings.test_contract: Read/hash/write/restore/close cancellation, source replacement, inherited ACL, non-cloning filesystems and Windows share denial; only open upstream work when released public API fails an independently captured case.
Explicit logical names and AppleDouble metadata for Windows-unrepresentable native names; no automatic renaming or reinterpretation of unrelated files.
Reuse released native/AppleDouble reads and mutations; qualify sign/verify/display sequencing and export/native restoration.
Native-produced encrypted/segmented/sparse image signing needs must be measured; SDK owning a codec does not prove codesign needs to decode it.

classification_limits: Single-probe acceptance/rejection records one exact fixture/value only; ignored/default/precedence/representation behavior remains to be captured. Future case families are specifications, not fabricated observations.

source_reviews.finding: ProcessCode::csops selects csops_audittoken or csops using the actual PID/audit token.
KernelCode asks for dynamic CDHash/status and checks PID/audit-token inputs; disk metadata is not the source of those results.
Native detached registration uses SQLite schema at /private/var/db/DetachedSignatures; isolated offline data does not update the active store.
doRemoteSigning requires a certificate chain and signing callback, builds CMS attributes, and invokes the callback with digest/algorithm identifiers. It does not specify a network wire protocol.
Portable remote signing uses a project-specific WebSocket relay/session protocol; this is design input, not Apple --remote-signing protocol proof.
The keychain implementation imports security_framework and security_framework_sys and uses SecKey/SecKeychain. It does not solve this project's zero-native-runtime boundary.
Device-backed signing is a separate provider implementation requiring an actual YubiKey and its access path. A software signer cannot reproduce non-exportable key access.
Submission/account workflow and network transport are broader than codesign ticket checking; do not import the entire notarization product as CLI parity.

CMS construction separates code-directory hashing, signer parameters and timestamping; useful design input, with x509tools/certloader dependencies requiring separate guard/license review before reuse.
